samples.pred: {"mood":"friendly","line":"Indeed, traveler. A few vegetables would be a welcome aid, especially with the chill coming in. I'll give you four.","calls":[{"tool":"give_item","args":{"item_id":"fresh_vegetables","qty":4}}]}

{"mood":"wary","line":"Aye, the wind's been fierce lately. Best to keep a close eye on the harbor, stranger. It's a poor time for shipping, and the sea's moods are... unpredictable.","calls":[{"tool":"steer_dialogue_node","args":{"node_id":"ask_squall"}}]}
{"mood":"cryptic","line":"The tides of knowledge shift with the moon, traveler. Some things are best left undisturbed, lest they unravel the threads of what we know.","calls":[]}

{"mood":"wary","line":"The wind bites sharper than usual, and the tides have been restless. Folks are quiet, mostly, tending to their hearths and hoping the harvest doesn't fail. There's a quiet unease in the air, a feeling of things holding their breath.","calls":[]}
{"mood":"wary","line":"A bit of coin for a bit of a deal, traveler. I'm a baker, not a merchant, so I'm not a fool.","calls":[{"tool":"give_item","args":{"item_id":"fresh_vegetables","qty":3}}]}

{"mood":"wary","line":"Aye, a nasty one. It churned the wind and the tides, aye. Best to keep a sharp eye on the waves and the winds, stranger.","calls":[{"tool":"steer_dialogue_node","args":{"node_id":"ask_squall"}}]}
{"mood":"calm","line":"The tides shift and the stars shift, traveler. I tend to the hearth and the old songs, seeking solace in the quiet rhythms of the world.","calls":[]}

{"mood":"wary","line":"The wind bites harder than it used to, traveler. Folk are quiet, and the tides have been restless, whispering of shifts in the deep. Best to keep a sharp eye on the water and the stars.","calls":[]}
